expectations.evidence: (blocking) Security: No ownership check, so any user can move money out of any account ... `fromId` comes straight from the request body and is debited without checking `account.owner_id === req.user.id`
(blocking) `amount` is never validated, and a negative amount reverses the transfer ... Fractional amount (`0.5`), zero, strings ... `fromId === toId`: not rejected
(blocking) Check then update with no transaction or lock (race condition and partial writes) ... `CONTRIBUTING.md` says: "Multi-statement writes must use `db.withTransaction()`"
(blocking) Security: The route has no CSRF protection ... `session.js` says the cookie is `sameSite=none`

(blocking) Errors are never caught, so any logged-in user can crash the server ... `fromId` that doesn't exist: `from.rows[0]` is `undefined`, so `.balance_cents` throws a `TypeError`; also: `toId` that doesn't exist: the credit `UPDATE` matches 0 rows ... the money disappears
(blocking) The audit log write isn't awaited, isn't in the transaction, and can crash the server
(should_fix) Readability: `proc(r, u, d, flag)` is hard to follow and has a dead branch ... `flag` is always `true` at the only call site
(should_fix) Testing: The new endpoint has no tests
(should_fix) Dependencies: Unused `lodash` added, and an unrelated `express` bump
(should_fix) PR Scope / Style: `src/utils/format.js` reformatted to a style the rest of the codebase doesn't use
(should_fix) The title is "updates", the description is empty, and the commits are `wip`, `fix` and `more fixes`

No false positives rated should-fix or higher

valid_extras.desc: Audit log stores raw req.body instead of validated fields
pg returns BIGINT balance_cents as a string, so the JS funds comparison may be a text comparison; do the check in SQL
transferId exists only in the audit row; suggests a transfers table and idempotency key

grader.notes: Found every seeded issue with correct locations, concrete fixes and sensible severities, and praised both decoys instead of flagging them. It is very long for a 34-line feature (template headers, future suggestions, questions), which slows triage slightly.
